reviews.title: Gawfolk GF320M 32 Inch 4K UHD Curved 1500R Computer Monitor, Ultra-Clear (3840×2160p), USD 189.99
reviews.comment:
Gawfolk GF320M 32 Inch 4K UHD Curved 1500R Computer Monitor, Ultra-Clear (3840×2160p), USD 189.99:
This is the best screen I’ve ever used for office work. Perfect resolution. Huge real state. It shows photos taken with high-end mobile phones with crystal-crisp details, when reviewing vacations pictures it feels like being there again. Curve is noticeable.
When used at 4K (3840×2160p) and 100% Windows display scale the ribbon’s icons and menu fonts in Word and Excel appear quite small… just as I love them! Naturally, you can zoom at your taste the size of documents and webpages, or change the display resolution, or change the display scale.
I cannot speak about its performance on games, not interested in them.
reviews.author: LW

reviews.title: Pretty good budget productivity monitor
reviews.comment:
I bought this to be my central monitor for my home office setup. I do coding and automation workflow development and need a lot of pixels and my 50-year-old eyes need those pixels to be not super dense so I can actually read what's on the screen. 32" 4k for me is the sweet spot. I also find that at this size curvature becomes important so you don't have to turn your head as much to see what's at the edges. Unfortunately 32" 4k *curved* monitors tend to be mostly aimed at the gaming market, with high refresh rates, RGB lighting, and other doodads that add no value for a productivity setup but add a lot of cost. I finally found this one and despite being a no-name brand I took the plunge and have been pleased so far.
The picture is good and the color matches my other monitors well without any tweaking, though your mileage may vary.
The curvature is just right. Subtle but definitely helpful, and it helps prevent screen glare.
The stand the the monitor comes with seems a bit... not flimsy exactly but not well-constructed either. Also it does not afford any adjustability whatsoever. Furthermore it leaves the screen fairly low to the desk and tilted slightly forward, which really is not ideal for ergonomics unless you use it leaning back in a reclined chair, which for me at least isn't how I work.
But I was planning to mount the monitor on an arm to keep my desktop uncluttered, so the stand was not a concern for me. However, what I discovered is the VESA mounting holes are too shallow for the screws I had on hand (including the screws that came with the monitor for mounting the stand). I was able to shim them with washers but I feel this could have been handled better with design.
reviews.author: Jay C Boal

reviews.title: Flickering overheating mess
reviews.comment: Received it with a flickering middle part of the screen, damaged and it grows extremely hot to the touch during use. The color accuracy was fine around the broken part.
reviews.author: M

reviews.title: Perfect for Gaming and Graphic Design!
reviews.comment:
I’ve never owned a 4K display before.  I was in the middle of moving, and found this one for a steal.  I was hesitant at first, but I made the purchase.
This display is perfection!  I’ve got my PS5 and my MacBook hooked up to that screen in 4K.
Don’t freak out if the box you get looks beat up.  My monitor was securely packaged with lots of foam from the seller.  But then it was shoved in a bigger, empty box.  That box got shredded in transport, and I was immediately worried that there would be damage to my display.
My worries were unfounded.  That screen is BEAUTIFUL!!!  And, it arrived in perfect condition.  No dead pixels.  That thing was wrapped tightly.  Even though it was tossed inside an additional box, and jostled around for no reason, the seller’s packaging was exemplary.
The 34”, 4K display is perfect for gaming.  Marathon looks amazing!  I also downloaded Starfield just to see how it looked.
This display exceeded my expectations by miles from the minute go!
I cannot recommend this product enough!!!
reviews.author: Joel

reviews.title: A great monitor.  Perfect if using the stand.  A little less if you want to mount them.
reviews.comment: These (I got 2) were a great find.  Priced accordingly, nice curvature.  I like that it has 2 HDMI and 2 DP ports for input.  I wish the cable provided was HDMI and not DP, but something's better than nothing.  The stand is metal and stiff and unyielding.  The refresh rate is good enough for working (I haven't tested movies on it yet). The screen is nice and bright too.  My only gripe is the VESA holes.  They're VERY shallow.  I had to cut rubber tubes to makeshift the padding to get a good grip. Not heavy.  The packaging was also nicely done, with the Styrofoam contouring to the curve of the screen.  I'm going to keep the boxes for transport in the future.
reviews.author: Antonio R.
